THE PROBLEM

Did you know that globally humans cut down around 900,000 trees daily for paper products, including 27,000 trees for toilet paper alone? The average person uses 19ft of toilet paper per day. That’s a lot of trees that will take decades to replace, or that may never be replaced. We wanted to find a sustainable alternative.

OUR SOLUTION

Because bamboo and sugarcane are grasses, not hardwoods like trees, they are fast growing and do not require replanting. That makes bamboo and sugarcane a sustainable alternative to conventional paper made from trees, as part of an effort to minimize our overall environmental footprint.

We aim to use the most innovative technology and materials in order to provide sustainable, treeless paper that is also luxuriously soft and very strong.

THE PROBLEM

Did you know that globally humans cut down around 900,000 trees daily for paper products, including 27,000 trees for toilet paper alone? The average person uses 19ft of toilet paper per day. That’s a lot of trees that will take decades to replace, or that may never be replaced. We wanted to find a sustainable alternative.

OUR SOLUTION

Because bamboo and sugarcane are grasses, not hardwoods like trees, they are fast growing and do not require replanting. That makes bamboo and sugarcane a sustainable alternative to conventional paper made from trees, as part of an effort to minimize our overall environmental footprint.

We aim to use the most innovative technology and materials in order to provide sustainable, treeless paper that is also luxuriously soft and very strong.

THE PROBLEM

Did you know that globally humans cut down around 900,000 trees daily for paper products, including 27,000 trees for toilet paper alone? The average person uses 19ft of toilet paper per day. That’s a lot of trees that will take decades to replace, or that may never be replaced. We wanted to find a sustainable alternative.

OUR SOLUTION

Because bamboo and sugarcane are grasses, not hardwoods like trees, they are fast growing and do not require replanting. That makes bamboo and sugarcane a sustainable alternative to conventional paper made from trees, as part of an effort to minimize our overall environmental footprint.

We aim to use the most innovative technology and materials in order to provide sustainable, treeless paper that is also luxuriously soft and very strong.

THE PROBLEM

Did you know that globally humans cut down around 900,000 trees daily for paper products, including 27,000 trees for toilet paper alone? The average person uses 19ft of toilet paper per day. That’s a lot of trees that will take decades to replace, or that may never be replaced. We wanted to find a sustainable alternative.

OUR SOLUTION

Because bamboo and sugarcane are grasses, not hardwoods like trees, they are fast growing and do not require replanting. That makes bamboo and sugarcane a sustainable alternative to conventional paper made from trees, as part of an effort to minimize our overall environmental footprint.

We aim to use the most innovative technology and materials in order to provide sustainable, treeless paper that is also luxuriously soft and very strong.

THE PROBLEM

Did you know that globally humans cut down around 900,000 trees daily for paper products, including 27,000 trees for toilet paper alone? The average person uses 19ft of toilet paper per day. That’s a lot of trees that will take decades to replace, or that may never be replaced. We wanted to find a sustainable alternative.

OUR SOLUTION

Because bamboo and sugarcane are grasses, not hardwoods like trees, they are fast growing and do not require replanting. That makes bamboo and sugarcane a sustainable alternative to conventional paper made from trees, as part of an effort to minimize our overall environmental footprint.

We aim to use the most innovative technology and materials in order to provide sustainable, treeless paper that is also luxuriously soft and very strong.

  • 100% biodegradable and septic safe for all disposal systems - rapid quick dissolve toilet paper specifically designed for RV campers, boats, camping, travel, backpacking, and more
  • Soft & Strong 2 ply sheets give you the perfect combination of bamboo's strength & sugarcane's softest fibers>
  • Hypoallergenic, BPA free, fragrance free, paraben free, free of elemental chlorine, non-GMO project verified, and wrapped in recycled paper, giving you full honest transparency and unmatched excellence
  • Contains a total of 8 big rolls with 500 sheets per roll. Total of 4000 sheets. Caboo's manufacturing facility is accredited by BRC, FSC, FDA and ISO certifications. We are proudly "Panda Friendly" by sourcing bamboo which is not a food source for panda bears.

THE PROBLEM

Did you know that globally humans cut down around 900,000 trees daily for paper products, including 27,000 trees for toilet paper alone? The average person uses 19ft of toilet paper per day. That’s a lot of trees that will take decades to replace, or that may never be replaced. We wanted to find a sustainable alternative.

OUR SOLUTION

Because bamboo and sugarcane are grasses, not hardwoods like trees, they are fast growing and do not require replanting. That makes bamboo and sugarcane a sustainable alternative to conventional paper made from trees, as part of an effort to minimize our overall environmental footprint.

We aim to use the most innovative technology and materials in order to provide sustainable, treeless paper that is also luxuriously soft and very strong.

Zuerst kam Holz, dann kam die Leinwand, und jetzt stellen wir unsere gerahmte Giclée-Wandkunst vor. Wie immer in den USA hergestellt, beginnen wir mit einer Giclée-Lithografie auf Holz montiert und vervollständigen sie mit einem strukturierten Pinselstrich. Wir haben es aber nicht aufgehört, da wir es in einen 3,8 cm dicken Ebenholzrahmen passen, um Tiefe und Dimension hinzuzufügen. Fertig zum Aufhängen.

جاءت الخشب لأول مرة، ثم أتت اللوحة القماشية، والآن نقدم "اللوحة الفنية الجدارية المزخرفة بالحبر النفاث". مصنوع في الولايات المتحدة الأمريكية بنسبة 100% كما هو الحال دائمًا، نبدأ بالطباعة الحجرية الجيكلية المثبتة على الخشب، وننتهي الأمر بلمسة نهائية منسوجة للفرشاة. لم نتوقف ذلك لأننا نناسبها ضمن إطار من خشب الأبنوس بسمك 3.81 سم لإضافة العمق والأبعاد. جاهزة للتعليق.

Primeiro veio a madeira, depois veio a tela, e agora apresentamos nossa "arte de parede texturizada giclée emoldurada". 100% feito nos EUA como sempre, começamos com uma litografia giclée montada em madeira, e terminamos com um acabamento texturizado. Nós não paramos por aí, pois o ajustamos dentro de uma moldura de grão de madeira ébano de 3,8 cm de espessura para adicionar profundidade e dimensão. Pronto para pendurar.

首先是木頭,然後是帆布,現在我們介紹我們的「裱框藝術微噴紋理牆面藝術」。 100% 美國製造,我們從安裝在木頭上的 Giclee 平版印刷開始,並以紋理刷行程完成。 我們沒有停下來,因為我們將它放在厚約 3.8 公分的烏木木紋框架中以增加深度和尺寸。 可直接懸掛。

首先是木材,然后是帆布,现在我们介绍我们的"裱框艺术微喷纹理墙壁艺术"。 100% 美国制造,我们从安装在木材上的艺术微喷平版印刷画开始,并用纹理笔触完成处理。 我们并没有止步,因为我们将它安装在 3.81 厘米厚的乌木木纹框架内,以增加深度和尺寸。 可直接悬挂。

먼저 나무가 나왔고 캔버스가 나왔고, 이제 '액자에 끼운 지클레이 텍스처 벽 예술'을 소개합니다. 100% 미국에서 제작되어 항상 나무에 지클레이 석판 인쇄를 사용하여 질감을 살린 브러시 스트로크 마감으로 마무리합니다. 깊이와 치수를 더하기 위해 3.8cm 두께의 흑단 나뭇결 프레임에 맞기 때문에 저희는 거기서 멈추지 않았습니다. 바로 걸 수 있습니다.

Die durchschnittliche Person verwendet 5,8 m Toilettenpapier pro Tag. Das sind viele Bäume, die Jahrzehnte dauern werden, um zu ersetzen oder die möglicherweise nie ersetzt werden. Wir wollten eine nachhaltige Alternative finden.Unsere LösungWeil Bambus und Zuckerrohr Gräser sind, keine Harthölzer wie Bäume, sie wachsen schnell und müssen nicht umgepflanzt werden. THE PROBLEM

Did you know that globally humans cut down around 900,000 trees daily for paper products, including 27,000 trees for toilet paper alone? The average person uses 19ft of toilet paper per day. That’s a lot of trees that will take decades to replace, or that may never be replaced. We wanted to find a sustainable alternative.

OUR SOLUTION

Because bamboo and sugarcane are grasses, not hardwoods like trees, they are fast growing and do not require replanting. That makes bamboo and sugarcane a sustainable alternative to conventional paper made from trees, as part of an effort to minimize our overall environmental footprint.

We aim to use the most innovative technology and materials in order to provide sustainable, treeless paper that is also luxuriously soft and very strong.
